map.配制强度 fcu0=fcu,k+1.645σ（σ 随等级取 4/5/6）；水泥实: Design strength fcu0=fcu,k+1.645*sigma (sigma taken as 4/5/6 by grade); actual cement strength fce=grade*1.13; water-cement ratio W/C=A*fce/(fcu0+A*B*fce), with crushed stone A=0.53/B=0.20 and pebble A=0.4...
